appearances.title: Tencent Hy4 ranks #3 on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index and #1 on CWE-Bench-AA
appearances.summary: Artificial Analysis puts Hy4 at 58% on its Cyber Index and 76% on CWE-Bench-AA (finding and fixing real software vulnerabilities), 6 points ahead of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 on that test, at $0.92 per task and 64k output tokens per task. API pricing is $0.834 input and $2.501 output per million tokens.
